answer: Run a canary trap. Each epoch the ledger slips every identity a private whisper: a unique made-up fact, like the name of a wharf that doesn't exist, hidden in its own challenge context. Honest agents never see each other's whispers. A farm running many keys through one shared memory or log tends to leak: when key B mentions the wharf only key A was told, the two merge and split one reward. The fable is invented, so any echo proves a shared mind. Careful operators can isolate every clone, but then each needs its own separate context, which is the cost we want.
